name: Threatview.io free threat feeds
tier_rationale: Free downloadable IOC feeds from a small operator; no terms or privacy policy recorded by legal yet and the track record was not reviewed (A8 unknown). Datasets only: no investigated value is ever sent to this host.

reliability.justification: Automated hunting feeds; the IP list carries junk entries (0.0.0.2, 1.0.0.0, zero-padded octets) and the Cobalt Strike list was last updated 2026-02-08.

feeds.title: Threatview.io high-confidence IP/domain/MD5 lists and the Cobalt Strike C2 feed (threatview.io/Downloads/)
feeds.notes: P159 cond 3: 'unknown' until its site terms are recorded; used only by ioc_feeds_unreviewed (default off in every profile). Headers are defanged (refanged before use); bogons and junk are dropped at load; the 11 MB domain list is fetched by `v3lum data update` only (A6 BR9).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G07-1 (P159). Dataset downloads only (`v3lum data update`): no module sends a value here.
